workflow_name: A paper's place in its author's oeuvre
description: Evgeny, 2026-09-07: what role does one paper play in the author's oeuvre? Six engines over the focal text and the profiles of the author's other texts: the agendas and turns, the citation shifts, the text read as a culmination (before only), as an origin (after only), the rupture test, and the memo that joins them with a reading route and the actions the findings license. Runs as the dossier recipe oeuvre_position (engines only); read back as GET /v1/dossier/jobs/{id}/oeuvre.

phases.phase_description: The oeuvre's research agendas, the turns between them, the focal text's place.
First citations, drops, carried citations, anomalies, unexamined literature (the action rows).
The focal text with only what came before: inheritance, resolution, interlocutors, culmination verdict. Scope: focal + before.
The focal text with only what came after: seeds, uptake, abandoned, origin verdict. Scope: focal + after.
Continuity and break across the focal text; the verdict and the two halves; the tests.
The holistic reading: the joined verdict, what to read next, the open question; the actions the findings license.

output_description: The memo on the paper's place, its verdicts, a reading route and suggested actions.
